thread:
Marta (AE): Kickoff: CatalystOne perf POC. Ask: sustain 5k QPS, p95 <= 180ms, short-gen (~20 in / 40 out). Need test plan, infra suggestion, and a simple pricing appendix for reserved vs burst. Can we scope today?
Eli (Perf Eng): Quick confirm: single region us-east, no A/B logic?
Marta (AE): Correct, single region for POC. No custom plugins.
Sima (Solutions Eng): Recommend dedicated pool: 6 nodes x 8 GPUs (A10-ish), INT8 quantized model variant, continuous batching, target batch size 24-32. Warmup 20m at 25% sustained qps.
Connor (SRE): Ops notes: enable VPC peering to avoid NAT latency; pre-warm runtime to avoid cold starts. We'll also set autoscale cooldown to 2m.
Eli (Perf Eng): Short load plan:
- Smoke (5m) 50 qps
- Ramp (20m) 50->5k linear
- Steady (45m) 5k, collect p50/p95/p99, batch sizes, cache hit%
- Spikes (4x) 15k qps, 90s each
Metrics: GPU util, queue latency, tokens/sec, KV hit rate
Priya (Sales Eng): Pricing sketch for proposal: reserved pool vs burst overlay + security add-ons?
Sima (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: reserved pool ~$48k/mo. Burst overlay +40% unit cost during spike windows. KMS/HSM + audit retention ~ $2.5k/mo. INT8 reduces GPU runtime cost ~15-20% but needs quality eval.
sec-bot: Security reminder: customer requires BYOK and 180d audit retention 0:00
Connor (SRE): We'll enforce region-scoped cache and disable cross-region replication for POC to satisfy residency.
Eli (Perf Eng): Action items: I'll run 1k/3k/5k staging calibrations and paste results here by 3pm. Sima to draft the cost appendix. Priya to own proposal numbers.
Marta (AE): Great, I'll brief the customer and request their security contact. If numbers look good we'll schedule the full run Fri AM. :thumbsup:
